name: Transform.position
description: The world space position of the Transform. Setting this teleports the object without physics interaction.

name: Transform.Translate
description: Moves the transform by the given direction and distance. Can operate in self or world space.
signature: void Transform.Translate(Vector3 translation, Space relativeTo = Space.Self)

name: Transform.Rotate
description: Applies a rotation of eulerAngles.z degrees around the z-axis, eulerAngles.x around the x-axis, and eulerAngles.y around the y-axis (in that order).
signature: void Transform.Rotate(Vector3 eulers, Space relativeTo = Space.Self)

name: Transform.LookAt
description: Rotates the transform so the forward vector points at the target position. worldUp defaults to Vector3.up.
signature: void Transform.LookAt(Transform target, Vector3 worldUp = Vector3.up)

name: Transform.SetParent
description: Sets the parent of the transform. If worldPositionStays is true, the world position/rotation/scale is maintained.
signature: void Transform.SetParent(Transform parent, bool worldPositionStays = true)

name: GameObject.SetActive
description: Activates or deactivates the GameObject. Inactive GameObjects do not receive Update, FixedUpdate, or rendering calls.

name: GameObject.GetComponent
description: Returns the component of the specified type. Returns null if no component is found. Cache the result instead of calling per frame.

name: GameObject.AddComponent
description: Adds a component of the specified type to the GameObject. Returns the newly added component.

name: GameObject.CompareTag
description: Compares the tag of the GameObject against the given string. Faster than string comparison and does not allocate.

name: Object.Instantiate
description: Clones the original object and returns the clone. Can optionally set parent and world position. Consider object pooling for frequent spawning.
signature: T Object.Instantiate<T>(T original, Vector3 position, Quaternion rotation, Transform parent = null)

name: Object.Destroy
description: Removes the GameObject, component, or asset. Optional delay parameter. The object is destroyed at the end of the frame.

name: Object.DontDestroyOnLoad
description: Preserves the target object when loading a new scene. Only works on root GameObjects.

name: MonoBehaviour.StartCoroutine
description: Starts a coroutine. Returns a Coroutine handle that can be used with StopCoroutine. Consider Awaitable in Unity 6+.

name: MonoBehaviour.Invoke
description: Invokes a method by name after a delay. Not type-safe - prefer coroutines or Awaitable for delayed execution.

name: Rigidbody.AddForce
description: Adds a force to the Rigidbody. ForceMode determines whether it is a continuous force, acceleration, impulse, or velocity change.
signature: void Rigidbody.AddForce(Vector3 force, ForceMode mode = ForceMode.Force)

name: Rigidbody.MovePosition
description: Moves the Rigidbody to the specified position while respecting physics interpolation. Call in FixedUpdate.

name: Rigidbody.velocity
description: The velocity vector of the Rigidbody in world space. Setting directly bypasses physics simulation - prefer AddForce for realistic movement.

name: Rigidbody2D.AddForce
description: Adds a force to the 2D Rigidbody. Works identically to Rigidbody.AddForce but in 2D space.
signature: void Rigidbody2D.AddForce(Vector2 force, ForceMode2D mode = ForceMode2D.Force)

name: Physics.Raycast
description: Casts a ray and returns true if it hits a collider. Use layerMask to filter which layers to test. Prefer non-allocating overloads.
signature: bool Physics.Raycast(Vector3 origin, Vector3 direction, out RaycastHit hitInfo, float maxDistance, int layerMask)
example: if (Physics.Raycast(transform.position, transform.forward, out var hit, 100f)) Debug.Log(hit.collider.name);

name: Physics.OverlapSphere
description: Returns all colliders within a sphere. Use OverlapSphereNonAlloc to avoid garbage allocation.
signature: Collider[] Physics.OverlapSphere(Vector3 position, float radius, int layerMask)

name: Physics2D.Raycast
description: Casts a 2D ray and returns the first hit. Use layerMask to filter collision layers.
signature: RaycastHit2D Physics2D.Raycast(Vector2 origin, Vector2 direction, float distance, int layerMask)

name: Camera.ScreenToWorldPoint
description: Transforms position from screen space to world space. The z component of the input is the distance from the camera.

name: Camera.WorldToScreenPoint
description: Transforms position from world space to screen space. Z is the distance from the camera in world units.

name: Camera.ViewportToWorldPoint
description: Transforms from viewport space (0-1 range) to world space. Useful for positioning UI or screen-relative objects.

name: AudioSource.Play
description: Plays the AudioClip assigned to the AudioSource. If already playing, restarts from the beginning.

name: AudioSource.PlayOneShot
description: Plays an AudioClip without stopping the current clip. Good for overlapping sound effects like gunshots.

name: AudioSource.PlayClipAtPoint
description: Static method that creates a temporary AudioSource at the given world position, plays the clip, and destroys the source after playback.
signature: static void AudioSource.PlayClipAtPoint(AudioClip clip, Vector3 position, float volume = 1f)

name: Animator.SetTrigger
description: Sets a trigger parameter, causing the Animator to transition to the associated state. Resets automatically after consumption.

name: Animator.SetBool
description: Sets a bool parameter in the Animator Controller. Used for toggling states like IsRunning or IsGrounded.

name: Animator.SetFloat
description: Sets a float parameter in the Animator Controller. Used for blend trees (speed, direction) and gradual transitions.

name: Animator.Play
description: Plays a specific state immediately, bypassing transitions. Use the string hash overload for better performance.
signature: void Animator.Play(string stateName, int layer = -1, float normalizedTime = float.NegativeInfinity)

name: Debug.Log
description: Logs a message to the Unity Console. Expensive in builds - strip with Conditional attribute or preprocessor directives.
signature: static void Debug.Log(object message, Object context = null)

name: Debug.DrawRay
description: Draws a ray in the Scene view for visual debugging. Only visible in the Scene view, not in Game view.
signature: static void Debug.DrawRay(Vector3 start, Vector3 dir, Color color, float duration = 0f)

name: Mathf.Lerp
description: Linearly interpolates between a and b by t (clamped 0-1). For unclamped interpolation, use LerpUnclamped.
signature: static float Mathf.Lerp(float a, float b, float t)
example: float current = Mathf.Lerp(start, end, elapsed / duration);

name: Mathf.Clamp
description: Clamps value between min and max. Use Clamp01 for the common 0-1 range case.
signature: static float Mathf.Clamp(float value, float min, float max)

name: Mathf.SmoothDamp
description: Gradually changes a float towards a target value. Commonly used for smooth camera follow and UI transitions.
signature: static float Mathf.SmoothDamp(float current, float target, ref float currentVelocity, float smoothTime)

name: Vector3.Lerp
description: Linearly interpolates between two Vector3 values by t (clamped 0-1).
signature: static Vector3 Vector3.Lerp(Vector3 a, Vector3 b, float t)

name: Vector3.MoveTowards
description: Moves a point towards a target by a maximum distance. Does not overshoot. Good for constant-speed movement.
signature: static Vector3 Vector3.MoveTowards(Vector3 current, Vector3 target, float maxDistanceDelta)

name: Vector3.Distance
description: Returns the distance between two points. For distance checks, compare sqrMagnitude to avoid the sqrt cost.
signature: static float Vector3.Distance(Vector3 a, Vector3 b)

name: Quaternion.LookRotation
description: Creates a rotation with the specified forward and upward directions. Forward must not be zero.
signature: static Quaternion Quaternion.LookRotation(Vector3 forward, Vector3 upwards = Vector3.up)

name: Quaternion.Slerp
description: Spherically interpolates between two rotations by t (clamped 0-1). Produces smooth rotation blending.
signature: static Quaternion Quaternion.Slerp(Quaternion a, Quaternion b, float t)

name: Time.deltaTime
description: The interval in seconds from the last frame to the current frame. Use in Update for frame-rate-independent movement.

name: Time.fixedDeltaTime
description: The interval in seconds at which physics and FixedUpdate are called. Default is 0.02 (50Hz).

name: Time.timeScale
description: The scale at which time passes. Set to 0 to pause the game (affects Time.deltaTime and FixedUpdate). Use Time.unscaledDeltaTime for UI during pause.

name: SceneManager.LoadScene
description: Loads a scene by name or build index. Use LoadSceneAsync for non-blocking loading with progress tracking.
signature: static void SceneManager.LoadScene(string sceneName, LoadSceneMode mode = LoadSceneMode.Single)

name: SceneManager.LoadSceneAsync
description: Loads a scene asynchronously. Returns an AsyncOperation for progress tracking. Set allowSceneActivation to false to control when the scene activates.
signature: static AsyncOperation SceneManager.LoadSceneAsync(string sceneName, LoadSceneMode mode = LoadSceneMode.Single)

name: Application.persistentDataPath
description: A persistent data directory path where you can store save files. Survives app updates. Platform-specific location.

name: Application.targetFrameRate
description: Sets the target frame rate. -1 means platform default (typically VSync). Set in Awake or Start. Does not guarantee the target is hit.

name: Screen.SetResolution
description: Sets the screen resolution. On mobile, affects the render resolution. On desktop, changes the window or fullscreen resolution.
signature: static void Screen.SetResolution(int width, int height, FullScreenMode fullScreenMode)

name: PlayerPrefs.SetFloat
description: Stores a float value in persistent storage keyed by string. Limited storage - use file I/O for large save data.
signature: static void PlayerPrefs.SetFloat(string key, float value)

name: PlayerPrefs.GetFloat
description: Returns the float value stored at the given key. Returns defaultValue if the key does not exist.
signature: static float PlayerPrefs.GetFloat(string key, float defaultValue = 0f)

name: Awaitable.WaitForSecondsAsync
description: Async replacement for WaitForSeconds coroutine yield. Returns an Awaitable that completes after the given time. Unity 6+.
signature: static Awaitable Awaitable.WaitForSecondsAsync(float seconds, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

name: Awaitable.NextFrameAsync
description: Async replacement for yield return null. Suspends until the next frame. Unity 6+.

name: Awaitable.MainThreadAsync
description: Switches execution back to the main thread from a background thread. Unity 6+.
example: await Awaitable.BackgroundThreadAsync(); /* do work */ await Awaitable.MainThreadAsync();

name: Collider.OnTriggerEnter
description: Called when a Collider enters the trigger. At least one object must have a Rigidbody. Use CompareTag for type checking.
example: private void OnTriggerEnter(Collider other) { if (other.CompareTag("Pickup")) Collect(other); }

name: Addressables.LoadAssetAsync
description: Loads an addressable asset asynchronously by key or label. Returns an AsyncOperationHandle for tracking and releasing.

name: Addressables.InstantiateAsync
description: Instantiates an addressable prefab asynchronously. Must be released with Addressables.ReleaseInstance when done.
signature: static AsyncOperationHandle<GameObject> Addressables.InstantiateAsync(object key, Vector3 position, Quaternion rotation, Transform parent = null)

name: FindAnyObjectByType
description: Finds any loaded object of the given type. Faster than FindFirstObjectByType when ordering does not matter. Unity 2023.1+.

name: FindFirstObjectByType
description: Finds the first loaded object of the given type with deterministic ordering by instance ID. Unity 2023.1+.
